name: project-expense-monitoring
description: Project Expense Monitoring: React + Vite front end on Supabase, deployed on Vercel.

scripts.functions:deploy: supabase functions deploy oe-invite-user && supabase functions deploy oe-push
scripts.test:smoke: VITE_SUPABASE_URL= VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY= vite build --outDir dist-smoke && node scripts/smoke-test.mjs dist-smoke demo
